# Free Java Doc hosting for open source projects - javadoc.io

Source: https://javadoc.io/

#

				javadoc.io

				free, CDN enabled, new versions auto pick up

				Supports Java, Scala, Groovy... any language that generates a -javadoc.jar

# log4j 3.0.0-beta3 javadoc (org.apache.logging.log4j)

Source: https://javadoc.io/doc/org.apache.logging.log4j/log4j

No JavaDoc is released for artifact

org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j:3.0.0-beta3.
  Please try other versions.

  Owner of the project? Troubleshoot following things:

-
      [Retry](/retry/org.apache.logging.log4j/log4j/3.0.0-beta3)this version.
      Sometimes it's just a matter of time to pick up new versions.
- Is the log4j-3.0.0-beta3-javadoc.jar actually distributed to either maven or bintray?
- Does the log4j-3.0.0-beta3-javadoc.jar file contains an index.html in the extracted root folder? (you can rename .jar to .zip to extract the file)

[
    ](https://github.com/maxcellent/javadoc.io/issues)
  if you tried everything but still doesn't work.

No JavaDoc is released for artifact

org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-api-kotlin:1.5.0.
  Please try other versions.

  Owner of the project? Troubleshoot following things:

-
      [Retry](/retry/org.apache.logging.log4j/log4j-api-kotlin/1.5.0)this version.
      Sometimes it's just a matter of time to pick up new versions.
- Is the log4j-api-kotlin-1.5.0-javadoc.jar actually distributed to either maven or bintray?
- Does the log4j-api-kotlin-1.5.0-javadoc.jar file contains an index.html in the extracted root folder? (you can rename .jar to .zip to extract the file)

[
    ](https://github.com/maxcellent/javadoc.io/issues)
  if you tried everything but still doesn't work.

# log4j-jdbc 3.0.0-beta3 javadoc (org.apache.logging.log4j)

Source: https://javadoc.io/doc/org.apache.logging.log4j/log4j-jdbc

No JavaDoc is released for artifact

org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-jdbc:3.0.0-beta3.
  Please try other versions.

  Owner of the project? Troubleshoot following things:

-
      [Retry](/retry/org.apache.logging.log4j/log4j-jdbc/3.0.0-beta3)this version.
      Sometimes it's just a matter of time to pick up new versions.
- Is the log4j-jdbc-3.0.0-beta3-javadoc.jar actually distributed to either maven or bintray?
- Does the log4j-jdbc-3.0.0-beta3-javadoc.jar file contains an index.html in the extracted root folder? (you can rename .jar to .zip to extract the file)

  Please try other versions.

  Owner of the project? Troubleshoot following things:

-
      [Retry](/retry/org.apache.logging.log4j/log4j-layout-jackson-json/3.0.0-alpha1)this version.
      Sometimes it's just a matter of time to pick up new versions.
- Is the log4j-layout-jackson-json-3.0.0-alpha1-javadoc.jar actually distributed to either maven or bintray?
- Does the log4j-layout-jackson-json-3.0.0-alpha1-javadoc.jar file contains an index.html in the extracted root folder? (you can rename .jar to .zip to extract the file)

    ](https://github.com/maxcellent/javadoc.io/issues)
  if you tried everything but still doesn't work.

# log4j-osgi 3.0.0-alpha1 javadoc (org.apache.logging.log4j)

Source: https://javadoc.io/doc/org.apache.logging.log4j/log4j-osgi

No JavaDoc is released for artifact

org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-osgi:3.0.0-alpha1.
  Please try other versions.

  Owner of the project? Troubleshoot following things:

-
      [Retry](/retry/org.apache.logging.log4j/log4j-osgi/3.0.0-alpha1)this version.
      Sometimes it's just a matter of time to pick up new versions.
- Is the log4j-osgi-3.0.0-alpha1-javadoc.jar actually distributed to either maven or bintray?
- Does the log4j-osgi-3.0.0-alpha1-javadoc.jar file contains an index.html in the extracted root folder? (you can rename .jar to .zip to extract the file)

[
    ](https://github.com/maxcellent/javadoc.io/issues)
  if you tried everything but still doesn't work.

org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-script:3.0.0-beta3.
  Please try other versions.

  Owner of the project? Troubleshoot following things:

-
      [Retry](/retry/org.apache.logging.log4j/log4j-script/3.0.0-beta3)this version.
      Sometimes it's just a matter of time to pick up new versions.
- Is the log4j-script-3.0.0-beta3-javadoc.jar actually distributed to either maven or bintray?
- Does the log4j-script-3.0.0-beta3-javadoc.jar file contains an index.html in the extracted root folder? (you can rename .jar to .zip to extract the file)

[
    ](https://github.com/maxcellent/javadoc.io/issues)
  if you tried everything but still doesn't work.

Source: https://javadoc.io/task/sync_latest/org.apache.logging.log4j/log4j-core

No JavaDoc is released for artifact

org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-core:3.0.0-beta3.
  Please try other versions.

  Owner of the project? Troubleshoot following things:

-
      [Retry](/retry/org.apache.logging.log4j/log4j-core/3.0.0-beta3)this version.
      Sometimes it's just a matter of time to pick up new versions.
- Is the log4j-core-3.0.0-beta3-javadoc.jar actually distributed to either maven or bintray?
- Does the log4j-core-3.0.0-beta3-javadoc.jar file contains an index.html in the extracted root folder? (you can rename .jar to .zip to extract the file)

[
    ](https://github.com/maxcellent/javadoc.io/issues)
  if you tried everything but still doesn't work.
